description:
In inbound.rs strip_html, every closing > triggers a 
 push. This means inline tags like <strong>, <em>, <a> etc. also insert newlines after closing, producing output like 'Hello 
world
' instead of 'Hello world'. For Usenet article injection this produces excessively line-broken plaintext, and the resulting article body misrepresents the original content. Block-level tags (p, div, br) should produce newlines; inline tags should not.
title: strip_html in inbound.rs inserts \n after every closing tag, not just block tags
